'''Lartan''' was a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi youngling]] who studied to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] alongside fellow [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] [[Kiri]], [[Lina Lascol]], [[Ezak]], and [[Mox Freedan]]. They were all members of [[Wolf Clan]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> one of several [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Jedi clans]] that young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were placed in when they commenced their Jedi [[Jedi training/Legends|training]].<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> They lived and trained together in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Lartan was mentioned in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TCSWE" />
